referenceCategory: Thailand rental-property discovery and inquiry preparation

standards.standard: Search by area, property type, budget, bedroom, and verified availability date.
standards.currentEvidence: candidate filters and verification date fields exist

standards.standard: Every listing shows source, owner/agent identity, authorization, freshness, and correction path.
standards.currentEvidence: source and checked-at fields appear in local state
standards.gap: no independently verified publisher or provenance workflow

standards.standard: Side-by-side normalized price, fees, term, amenities, transport, and evidence differences.
standards.currentEvidence: comparison controls and numeric contract/ad comparison are implemented
standards.gap: no structured external data normalization evidence

standards.standard: Language-aware inquiry draft with informed-consent and contact safety guidance.
standards.currentEvidence: Korean/English/Thai inquiry generation plus safety messages
standards.gap: no verified delivery, tracking, or support escalation

standards.standard: If transactions are offered, use identity checks, secure messaging, payment, contract disclosure, cancellation, and dispute procedures.
standards.currentEvidence: app warns that inquiry is not a booking or payment
standards.gap: not a transaction service; boundaries must remain conspicuous

standards.standard: Local-data explanation, export/delete controls, retention scope, and policy contact.
standards.currentEvidence: local storage and non-upload messaging in source
standards.gap: production policy and deletion/support verification not established

standards.standard: Responsive public entry point, install/offline behavior, and physical-device regression evidence.
standards.gap: separate /m/ endpoint returns 404; no current Android-device evidence

standards.standard: Monitoring, incident contact, listing corrections, uptime ownership, and release traceability.
standards.currentEvidence: many local test scripts and continuity records
standards.gap: no current operational evidence in this analysis
